title: SAT Linear Functions & Word Problems
description:
Linear functions in context are one of the most common setups on SAT Math. This lesson shows how to read slope and intercept in any word problem, build equations from words and tables, and handle inequalities, with six SAT-style practice questions.

You'll learn:
• Slope as a rate and the y-intercept as a starting value
• How to answer "What is the best interpretation of…?" questions
• How to build a linear equation from a table or a description
• Linear inequalities in context ("at most", "at least") and rounding the right way
• Rates restated in different units (the hardest version)

All practice questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Algebra → Linear functions).
